title: One preflight command for a new venture's site-wide invariants
problem: A new venture passes its own tests and still breaks a repository-wide invariant: launch date missing from launched.json, key order, mirror not regenerated, [hidden] CSS, broken inline script. These surface after merge as red main or a blocked Pages publish.
change: Add one command (e.g. `node platform/pages/venture-preflight.mjs <slug>`) that runs the existing launched.json, mirror (`regen.mjs --verify`), page-integrity and inline-script checks for one slug, reusing the existing tests rather than new logic. Name it as the one line in the ventures sub-prompt.
metric: Post-merge fix-up commits per 100 new-venture merges

history.note: Added platform/pages/venture-preflight.mjs (launched.json, build+check.mjs, regen --verify); first run found meter-keeper undated on main, fixed.
